name: La Crosse County, WI
findings: La Crosse County has 483 nonprofit organizations. 194 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 159 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, La Crosse County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in La Crosse County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 15 education organizations here list public events, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do education organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 43 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
